verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a Templates API (create, edit, list, validate, push templates between servers) but never mentions React Email, MJML, or any first-party documented email-as-code framework. The API is only a building block for syncing templates from version control, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author emails as code — React Email, MJML, or an equivalent maintained framework the vendor documents first-party — and keep templates in version control
